recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future edits to the specified concept definition should go through UTG/THO, with core revisited only if a core-owned narrative or example starts contradicting the THO definition.
issue_request: FHIR-39248 is an Applied FHIR-core Patient Administration issue with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked how the Sex for Clinical Use value "specified" relates to intersex and approved adding that the terms "Other" or "Complex" may be considered synonyms of "Specified" to the specified concept definition.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit explicitly mentions FHIR-39248. The relevant terminology was present in core during R5 development, renamed to Sex Parameter for Clinical Use in the FHIR-39219 change family, moved out of core in f3c0d3659c, and then removed from the Extension Pack in 7e35b16 after the terminology moved to THO.
additional_context: The FHIR-39248 Jira comment says the issue was resolved via UP-461, but local searches did not find UP-461. UP-452 contains the same requested definition text, references FHIR-39248 as Pro Forma Information, is Proposal Implemented, and is listed in THO 5.3.0 release notes. Current THO CodeSystem sex-parameter-for-clinical-use version 2.0.0 contains the requested sentence and a history row for up-452.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Current core has no local SFCU/SPCU CodeSystem or ValueSet definition to edit; its remaining Patient example points to the THO CodeSystem and its Patient narrative points to the Extension Pack extension.

related_jiras.note: UTG proposal that implements the exact FHIR-39248 specified-definition text in THO and references FHIR-39248 as Pro Forma Information.
Renamed Sex for Clinical Use to Sex Parameter for Clinical Use and explains why current core references the SPCU extension and THO terminology rather than owning the old SFCU CodeSystem locally.
THO history records this as the move of Gender Harmony terminology from the extension IG into THO.
